error.nom_deja_utilise: Another screen is already named "{nom}": choose a different name.
error.hauteur_hors_bornes: The usable height must be between {min} and {max} px.
error.budget_intenable: This screen overflows by {debordement} px. Increase the usable height, or remove a zone in "Blocks and modes".
error.champ_requis: This field must be filled in.
error.champ_format_invalide: This field does not match the expected format.
error.champ_type_invalide: This field does not have the expected type.
error.champ_valeur_non_autorisee: This value is not allowed for this field.
error.champ_valeur_figee: This field can only take a single value.
error.champ_trop_peu_d_elements: This field does not have enough items.
error.champ_trop_d_elements: This field has too many items.
error.selection_manquante: Check "Add" for a new item; if the list isn't empty, you can also pick an existing one.
error.service_incomplet: Fill in both service fields, or clear them both.
error.allumee_incomplet: Fill in both the "on" entity and its states, or clear them both.
error.champ_element_requis: This list must contain a value the screen requires ("Commands" for zones, "Default" for modes).
error.recette_sans_mode: This tile opens the Recipe view, but the "recette" mode is not in the screen's modes ("Blocks and modes" section): the screen will never show the recipe's resume point on the home screen. Add the "recette" mode in "Blocks and modes" before saving this tile.
error.budget_intenable_mode: The {mode} mode overflows by {debordement} px with these zones. Increase the usable height, remove a zone, or remove this mode.
error.alerte_pas_en_tete: The "Alert" mode, if present, must be first in the list: an alert must never yield to another mode.
error.ecran_deviendrait_invalide: This change would make the screen invalid: it was not saved. Open the "{section}" section to fix the inconsistency before continuing.

exporter.name: Export screens
exporter.description: Writes the configuration of every screen to config/home_desk_ecrans.yaml. Notes become comments above what they justify, readable in a git log.

importer.name: Import screens
importer.description: Reads config/home_desk_ecrans.yaml back and replaces every configured screen with its content. Validates the whole file before writing anything: a single invalid screen or a duplicate name refuses the entire import, nothing is changed.
